fusions.name: Dusk Dive
fusions.desc: You dive onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deal 14 wind damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of where you land. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stoop at Last Light
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 18 dark damage, rising to twice that from the full 7 tiles, and uses up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage per affliction.

fusions.name: Jinking Glide
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds and jinks you 2 tiles from where you stood, with 12% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Wingover
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
